Source6CommonProfileContext.description: Server-derived owner and deletion generation. Incoming values are expected context only; JWT subject + active session binding authorize the request.

Source6CommonClientContext.description: Owner/epoch are checked against the verified session and stored operation; revision/token only control presentation. They cannot grant access.

Source6LegacyPracticeRef5.description: Mode/script-specific task plus the canonical basic-question version. Server verifies article/snapshot/bundle/script/task/question mappings; caller IDs grant no authority.

AssessmentFeedback5.description: Durable semantic feedback shared by personal history and inference GET; no transient presentation context or stale lesson snapshot. Read current LessonState separately. support_issued/prepared_supports record prepared output components, not delivered help or prior-example status. Renderer binds every full example to an exact immutable support artifact and question, including examples embedded in feedback. Actual delivery uses the presentation ticket/observation protocol; generic feedback ACK is separate. Server derives English status from evidence, never from normalized text alone. Non-English/unverified is held via unassessable; no valid anchor/English success and a held retry preserves prior first/content_success with retry_outcome null. Verified English with unknown form can content-judge without form correction.

LegacyCommonPracticeContentRef.description: Mode/script-specific task plus the canonical basic-question version. Server verifies article/snapshot/bundle/script/task/question mappings; caller IDs grant no authority.

LegacyInferenceCorrection.description: Unicode code point offsets, end exclusive. Fragment must equal the submitted answer slice; replacement changes only one confirmed form.

LegacyInferenceFeedbackGeneration.description: input_gate is a deterministic held-input response, with no model invocation and null model/prompt revisions; validator/rubric revisions remain actual configured values. fixture/live continue their original provenance meaning.

LegacyCommonSupportArtifact.description: Prepared, immutable reviewed output component. Not evidence of received help. Exact text/hash is bound to the question/task; full examples cannot be hidden in untracked generic feedback. Role/language are explicit and do not come from ref suffixes/text detection. kind is a metric HelpKind, nullable only for question_meaning; null still records actual help/ref/role and never means no help. Default question_meaning/core_explanation is ko; an explicit response-language change uses an approved matching artifact, never silent replacement.

LegacyCommonEnglishAttemptStatus.description: Read-only server-derived eligibility from validated original-language evidence, independent of content judgement and form fidelity. English-looking normalized text is not proof.
